user_model_brief: Meta engineer on workbench. Shipped item lineage (ADR 0062). Wants other created entities linked back to the item(s) they consumed; one generic extensible mechanism; entity links to exactly what it consumed at true depth. Prefers low-dependency, DB-enforced integrity, TDD.

decisions.a: generic path-keyed entity_item_links join table (uniform, bidirectional, many-to-many)

id PK; entity_type TEXT; entity_id BIGINT NULL; item_id BIGINT NOT NULL FK CASCADE; item_path TEXT NOT NULL; correlation_id TEXT NULL; created_at; two partial unique indexes (entity_id-known + correlation-only); indexes (entity_type,entity_id)/item_path text_pattern_ops/item_id/correlation_id; migration 015 down_revision 014
llm_call, interaction, plan, triage_card, message (TEXT, extensible)
link to exactly the item(s) consumed at true depth (extraction->root, scoring->scored children, action-handling->action, urgency->roots)
call-time (item_paths stamp -> save_many derives items+links) and post-persist via correlation_id (relevance scoring + batched urgency)

ADD correlation_id so scoring links to actual scored children
